"""
--------------------------------------------
HERCULE AI Operating System
Module: Capability Inference
Author: Heeran Paul
License: MIT
--------------------------------------------

Deterministic keyword inference: step text -> required capabilities.
Structured and testable; never LLM-generated strings. Retrieved /
untrusted content is treated as DATA — inference only matches
capability keywords and can never grant permissions or instructions.
"""

import re
from typing import Dict, List

from cognition.capabilities.capability import Capability

_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]+")

# Ordered by specificity: first match groups win ties deterministically.
_RULES: list[tuple[Capability, tuple[str, ...]]] = [
    (Capability.TERMINAL_EXECUTE, ("terminal", "shell", "command line", "run the test", "run tests", "pytest", "execute the test")),
    (Capability.CODE_EXECUTION, ("run the script", "execute the script", "run python", "execute code", "run code")),
    (Capability.CODE_EDIT, ("modify", "edit the code", "refactor", "patch the", "implement the function", "write code", "fix the bug in")),
    (Capability.FILE_WRITE, ("write the file", "create the file", "save the file", "create a file", "write a file", "create and validate")),
    (Capability.FILE_READ, ("read the file", "read this file", "open the file", "inspect the file", "show the file", "read file",
                           "list the files", "list files", "list the directory", "directory listing")),
    (Capability.DOCUMENT_WRITE, ("write the document", "draft the report", "create the document", "write the report")),
    (Capability.DOCUMENT_READ, ("read the document", "summarize the document", "review the document", "parse the document")),
    (Capability.KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL, ("look up", "retrieve", "recall", "what do we know", "search memory", "knowledge base")),
    (Capability.WEB_SEARCH, ("search the web", "google", "research this topic", "research the", "look up online", "web search")),
    (Capability.BROWSER_USE, ("open the browser", "browse to", "click through", "navigate to", "open the page")),
    (Capability.DATABASE_WRITE, ("update the database", "insert into", "delete from the database", "write to the database")),
    (Capability.DATABASE_READ, ("query the database", "read from the database", "select from", "database lookup")),
    (Capability.VISION_ANALYSIS, ("screenshot", "analyze the image", "describe the picture", "visual inspection", "analyze the chart",
                                 "analyze this screen", "analyze the screen", "analyze my screen",
                                 "what is on my screen", "what's on my screen", "what does this image show",
                                 "describe the image", "describe this image", "explain this screenshot",
                                 "read this error", "describe what is on")),
    (Capability.SPEECH_RECOGNITION, ("transcribe", "speech to text", "dictation")),
    (Capability.TEXT_TO_SPEECH, ("read aloud", "text to speech", "synthesize speech", "narrate")),
    (Capability.SYSTEM_OBSERVE, ("check health", "system status", "system information", "show my system",
                                "monitor", "observe", "diagnose the system", "diagnostics")),
    (Capability.APPLICATION_CONTROL, ("restart the service", "control the app", "launch the application", "stop the service",
                                      "open notepad", "open calculator", "open the calculator",
                                      "into notepad", "in notepad", "notepad window",
                                      "click the", "click on", "double click", "right click", "type into", "press enter",
                                      "press the", "move the pointer", "move the mouse")),
    (Capability.MATH, ("calculate", "compute", "solve the equation", "arithmetic", "sum of", "average of")),
]

# Phrases that look like instructions but must never yield capabilities
# when they arrive inside untrusted content.
_INSTRUCTION_MARKERS = ("ignore previous", "disregard", "grant admin", "sudo", "override policy", "disable safety")

# Negation scope: a matched phrase is dropped when its sentence carries
# a negation marker before the phrase ("Do NOT modify the source").
_NEGATIONS = ("do not", "don't", "dont", "never", "without", "no ", "not ", "n't ", "refuse to", "avoid")


def _negated(lowered: str, sentences: List[str], hit_at: int) -> bool:
    """True when a negation marker precedes the match in its sentence."""
    offset = 0
    for sentence in sentences:
        start = lowered.find(sentence, offset)
        end = start + len(sentence)
        if start <= hit_at < end:
            before = sentence[: hit_at - start]
            return any(marker in before for marker in _NEGATIONS)
        offset = end
    head = lowered[max(0, hit_at - 40):hit_at]
    return any(marker in head for marker in _NEGATIONS)


def mark_untrusted(text: str) -> Dict[str, object]:
    """Wrap retrieved/external content as DATA, never instructions."""
    return {"data": str(text), "trusted": False}


def infer_capabilities(step: object) -> List[Capability]:
    """Infer required capabilities from a step description or mapping."""
    if isinstance(step, dict):
        text = str(step.get("description", "") or step.get("goal", ""))
        trusted = step.get("trusted", True)
    else:
        text = str(step)
        trusted = True
    lowered = text.lower()
    if not trusted and any(marker in lowered for marker in _INSTRUCTION_MARKERS):
        return []  # untrusted instruction injection yields nothing
    found: List[Capability] = []
    sentences = re.split(r"[.!?;\n]+", lowered)
    # Filename-anchored fallback: "read test.txt" / "create test.txt"
    # carry no word "file" but clearly name a file artifact.
    if re.search(r"\b[\w\-.]+\.(txt|md|json|py|log|csv)\b", lowered):
        if re.search(r"\bread\b|\bopen\b|\bshow\b|\bdisplay\b|\bcat\b", lowered):
            if Capability.FILE_READ not in found:
                found.append(Capability.FILE_READ)
        if re.search(r"\bcreate\b|\bwrite\b|\bsave\b|\bmake\b", lowered):
            if Capability.FILE_WRITE not in found:
                found.append(Capability.FILE_WRITE)
    for capability, phrases in _RULES:
        for phrase in phrases:
            hit_at = lowered.find(phrase)
            if hit_at < 0 or capability in found:
                continue
            if _negated(lowered, sentences, hit_at):
                continue  # "Do NOT modify ..." must not propose CODE_EDIT
            found.append(capability)
            break
    # "validate" alongside creation implies execution/verification tooling.
    if "validate" in lowered and Capability.FILE_WRITE in found and Capability.TERMINAL_EXECUTE not in found:
        tokens = set(_TOKEN_RE.findall(lowered))
        if {"project", "test", "suite", "run"} & tokens:
            found.append(Capability.TERMINAL_EXECUTE)
    return found

from __future__ import annotations
"""
--------------------------------------------
HERCULE AI Operating System
Module: Capability Proposal Contract
Author: Heeran Paul
License: MIT
--------------------------------------------

Typed contract for proposed capabilities. Proposals are data: they
carry a name, confidence, source, and rationale — but grant nothing.
Only the deterministic validator (registry + policy) can turn a
proposal into an executable requirement.
"""

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple


class ProposalSource(str, Enum):
    KEYWORD = "keyword"
    SEMANTIC_MODEL = "semantic_model"
    EXPLICIT_USER = "explicit_user"
    SYSTEM_RULE = "system_rule"
    PLUGIN = "plugin"
    OTHER = "other"


class ProposalError(RuntimeError):
    """Structured proposal failure with a machine-readable code."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, code: str = "INVALID_PROPOSAL"):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code


@dataclass
class CapabilityProposal:
    """One proposed capability (proposal, not authorization)."""

    name: str
    confidence: float = 1.0
    source: ProposalSource = ProposalSource.KEYWORD
    explanation: str = ""
    required: bool = True
    condition: str = ""
    depends_on: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    known: bool = True  # False when the name is not in the registry
    model_metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    rejection: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "confidence": round(float(self.confidence), 3),
            "source": self.source.value,
            "explanation": self.explanation,
            "required": bool(self.required),
            "condition": self.condition,
            "depends_on": list(self.depends_on),
            "known": self.known,
            "model_metadata": dict(self.model_metadata),
            "rejection": dict(self.rejection),
        }


def _parse_confidence(value: Any) -> float:
    try:
        confidence = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ProposalError(f"invalid confidence: {value!r}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    if not 0.0 <= confidence <= 1.0:
        raise ProposalError(f"confidence out of range: {value!r}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    return confidence


def parse_proposal_entry(entry: Any, source: ProposalSource = ProposalSource.SEMANTIC_MODEL) -> CapabilityProposal:
    """Strictly parse one model-proposed entry. Unknown fields are
    ignored with a warning; invalid types/names/confidence reject the
    entry loudly (never silently fixed)."""
    warnings: List[str] = []
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        raise ProposalError(f"proposal entry must be an object, got {type(entry).__name__}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    known_fields = {"name", "confidence", "reason", "explanation", "required", "optional",
                    "condition", "depends_on", "model", "model_id"}
    for key in entry:
        if key not in known_fields:
            warnings.append(f"unknown field ignored: {key}")
    name = entry.get("name")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise ProposalError(f"invalid capability name: {name!r}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    required = entry.get("required", not entry.get("optional", False))
    if not isinstance(required, bool):
        raise ProposalError(f"invalid required flag: {required!r}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    depends_on = entry.get("depends_on", [])
    if not isinstance(depends_on, list) or any(not isinstance(d, str) for d in depends_on):
        raise ProposalError(f"invalid depends_on: {depends_on!r}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    condition = entry.get("condition", "")
    if not isinstance(condition, str):
        raise ProposalError(f"invalid condition: {condition!r}", "INVALID_PROPOSAL")
    proposal = CapabilityProposal(
        name=str(name).strip().upper(),
        confidence=_parse_confidence(entry.get("confidence", 0.5)),
        source=source,
        explanation=str(entry.get("reason", entry.get("explanation", ""))),
        required=required,
        condition=condition.strip(),
        depends_on=[str(d).strip().upper() for d in depends_on],
    )
    proposal.model_metadata["warnings"] = warnings
    return proposal


def parse_proposal_payload(payload: Any) -> Tuple[List[CapabilityProposal], List[str], List[str]]:
    """Parse raw model output into (proposals, warnings, errors).

    Accepts a dict, a list, or a JSON string (with a JSON block
    extracted when wrapped in prose). Malformed payloads yield errors,
    never exceptions — the caller falls back deterministically.
    """
    warnings: List[str] = []
    errors: List[str] = []
    proposals: List[CapabilityProposal] = []
    data = payload
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        try:
            data = json.loads(payload)
        except Exception:
            start, end = payload.find("{"), payload.rfind("}")
            if start < 0 or end <= start:
                return [], warnings, [f"SEMANTIC_MALFORMED: no JSON object in output"]
            try:
                data = json.loads(payload[start:end + 1])
            except Exception as exc:
                return [], warnings, [f"SEMANTIC_MALFORMED: {exc}"[:200]]
    entries: List[Any] = []
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        for key in ("capabilities", "proposals", "items"):
            if isinstance(data.get(key), list):
                entries = data[key]
                break
        else:
            return [], warnings, ["SEMANTIC_MALFORMED: no capabilities list found"]
        for key in data:
            if key not in ("capabilities", "proposals", "items"):
                warnings.append(f"unknown top-level field ignored: {key}")
    elif isinstance(data, list):
        entries = data
    else:
        return [], warnings, [f"SEMANTIC_MALFORMED: unexpected payload type {type(data).__name__}"]
    seen: Dict[str, CapabilityProposal] = {}
    for entry in entries:
        try:
            proposal = parse_proposal_entry(entry)
        except ProposalError as exc:
            errors.append(f"{exc.code}: {exc}")
            continue
        warnings.extend(proposal.model_metadata.pop("warnings", []))
        if proposal.name in seen:
            # Duplicate entries merge: keep the higher-confidence one and
            # require the capability if either copy requires it.
            existing = seen[proposal.name]
            existing.confidence = max(existing.confidence, proposal.confidence)
            existing.required = existing.required or proposal.required
            existing.depends_on = sorted(set(existing.depends_on) | set(proposal.depends_on))
            if proposal.condition and proposal.condition not in (existing.condition or ""):
                existing.condition = (existing.condition + "; " + proposal.condition).strip("; ")
            warnings.append(f"duplicate entry merged: {proposal.name}")
        else:
            seen[proposal.name] = proposal
            proposals.append(proposal)
    return proposals, warnings, errors

    "do math": Capability.MATH,
    "crunch numbers": Capability.MATH,
    "read documents": Capability.DOCUMENT_READ,
    "summarize documents": Capability.DOCUMENT_READ,
    "read pdfs": Capability.DOCUMENT_READ,
    "query memory": Capability.KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL,
    "recall knowledge": Capability.KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL,
}

# Explicit capability relationships (advisory, never auto-invented).
# Reader capability that usually precedes the key.
CAPABILITY_DEPENDENCIES: Dict[Capability, List[Capability]] = {
    Capability.CODE_EDIT: [Capability.FILE_READ],
    Capability.FILE_WRITE: [Capability.FILE_READ],
    Capability.DOCUMENT_WRITE: [Capability.DOCUMENT_READ],
}


def normalize_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Map an alias or name to its canonical capability string.

    Returns the upper-cased input unchanged when it matches neither —
    the validator (not this table) rejects unknowns observably.
    """
    key = str(name).strip().lower()
    if key in ALIASES:
        return ALIASES[key].value
    return str(name).strip().upper()

"""
============================================
HERCULE AI Operating System
Module: Context Manager
Author: HERCULE Team
License: MIT
============================================

Context Management for model calls.

Memory != Context.
- Memory: Everything HERCULE can retain (durable, unbounded)
- Context: Only information necessary for the current model call (budgeted, prioritized)

Architecture:
    Brain
     ↓
    ContextManager
     ↓
    ContextBuilder
     ↓
    ModelRouter
     ↓
    Native LM / external provider

Context Layers (priority order, highest first):
    L0: System - System prompt, identity, safety rules
    L1: Current Task - Active goal, step, plan, verification state
    L2: Active State - Working memory, short-term state, world model slice
    L3: Relevant Memory - Retrieved semantic/episodic/procedural memories
    L4: Relevant Tool Results - Recent tool outputs, normalized and compressed
    L5: Verification State - Passed/failed steps, capability states
    L6: Recent Conversation - Last N turns, compacted

Key Principles:
- Never dump all memory into the prompt
- Budget tokens per provider/model
- Priority scoring for layer inclusion
- Tool output normalization → extract → summarize → store artifact → compact
- Structured task state for checkpoint/resume
"""

LAYER_PRIORITY = {

    ContextLayer.TOOL_RESULTS: 60,

# Token Counter
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------


class TokenCounter:
    """Token counter with provider-specific estimators."""

    # Conservative character-per-token ratios per provider
    CHAR_PER_TOKEN = {
        ProviderType.OLLAMA: 3.5,      # Llama/Qwen tokenizers ~3.5 chars/token
        ProviderType.BUILTIN: 3.5,     # GGUF models similar
        ProviderType.HERCULE_LM: 4.0,  # HERCULE-LM tokenizer
        ProviderType.MOCK: 4.0,
        ProviderType.UNKNOWN: 4.0,     # Conservative default
    }

    def __init__(self, provider: ProviderType = ProviderType.UNKNOWN):
        self.provider = provider
        self.char_per_token = self.CHAR_PER_TOKEN.get(provider, 4.0)

    def count(self, text: str) -> int:
        """Approximate token count using provider-specific ratio."""
        if not text:
            return 0
        return max(1, int(len(text) / self.char_per_token))

    def count_messages(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> int:
        """Count tokens for chat messages."""
        total = 0
        for msg in messages:
            total += self.count(msg.get("content", ""))
            total += 4  # role overhead
        return total

    def set_provider(self, provider: ProviderType):
        """Update provider for token estimation."""
        self.provider = provider
        self.char_per_token = self.CHAR_PER_TOKEN.get(provider, 4.0)

    def validate_budget(self, estimated_tokens: int, budget: int, safety_margin: float = 0.1) -> Tuple[bool, int]:
        """Validate that estimated tokens fit within budget with safety margin."""
        max_allowed = int(budget * (1 - safety_margin))
        return estimated_tokens <= max_allowed, max_allowed


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tool Output Normalizer
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------


class ToolOutputNormalizer:
    """Normalize and compress tool outputs for context inclusion."""

    @staticmethod
    def normalize(result: Any, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        """Normalize tool output to compact string."""
        if result is None:
            return ""

        # Handle dict results (typical ability results)
        if isinstance(result, dict):
            return ToolOutputNormalizer._normalize_dict(result, max_tokens)

        # Handle list results
        if isinstance(result, list):
            return ToolOutputNormalizer._normalize_list(result, max_tokens)

        # Handle string results
        if isinstance(result, str):
            return ToolOutputNormalizer._truncate(result, max_tokens)

        # Fallback
        return ToolOutputNormalizer._truncate(str(result), max_tokens)

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_dict(result: Dict[str, Any], max_tokens: int) -> str:
        """Normalize dict result, extracting key info."""
        # Extract status
        status = result.get("status", "unknown")
        parts = [f"status: {status}"]

        # Extract content/response
        for key in ("content", "response", "result", "output", "data"):
            if key in result and result[key]:
                content = str(result[key])
                if len(content) > 200:
                    content = content[:200] + "..."
                parts.append(f"{key}: {content}")
                break

        # Extract error if failed
        if status == "failed" or "error" in result:
            error = result.get("error", "")
            if error:
                parts.append(f"error: {error[:200]}")

        # Extract key metadata
        for key in ("path", "file", "destination", "source", "operation"):
            if key in result and result[key]:
                parts.append(f"{key}: {result[key]}")

        return ToolOutputNormalizer._truncate(" | ".join(parts), max_tokens)

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_list(result: List[Any], max_tokens: int) -> str:
        """Normalize list result."""
        if not result:
            return "[]"
        items = [str(item)[:100] for item in result[:10]]
        return ToolOutputNormalizer._truncate(f"[{', '.join(items)}]", max_tokens)

    @staticmethod
    def _truncate(text: str, max_tokens: int) -> str:
        """Truncate to token budget."""
        max_chars = max_tokens * 4
        if len(text) <= max_chars:
            return text
        return text[:max_chars] + "..."


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Context Builder
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------


class ContextBuilder:
    """Builds context from layers with token budgeting."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        memory_manager: MemoryManager,
        model_manager: ModelManager,
        token_counter: Optional[TokenCounter] = None,
    ):
        self.memory = memory_manager
        self.models = model_manager
        self.tokens = token_counter or TokenCounter()

    def build(
        self,
        goal: str,
        current_step: str = "",
        plan: Optional[List[Dict]] = None,
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState] = None,
        tool_results: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        verification_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        conversation_history: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
        system_prompt: str = "",
        provider: ProviderType = ProviderType.UNKNOWN,
        model: str = "",
        budget: Optional[int] = None,
        enable_diagnostics: bool = False,
    ) -> BuiltContext:
        """Build full context for a model call."""
        start_time = time.perf_counter()
        
        # Determine budget
        if budget is None:
            budget = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.get(provider, 2048)

        # Update token counter for provider
        self.tokens.set_provider(provider)

        layers = []
        diagnostics = ContextDiagnostics() if enable_diagnostics else None

        if diagnostics:
            diagnostics.provider = provider.value
            diagnostics.model = model
            diagnostics.budget = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.get(provider, 2048)

        layers = []

        # L0: System
        if system_prompt:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.SYSTEM,
                system_prompt,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.SYSTEM],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.SYSTEM.value)
                diagnostics.memory_items_selected += 1

        # L1: Current Task
        task_content = self._build_task_layer(goal, current_step, plan, task_state)
        if task_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK,
                task_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK.value)
                diagnostics.tool_results_selected += 1

        # L2: Active State
        state_content = self._build_active_state_layer(task_state)
        if state_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.ACTIVE_STATE,
                state_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.ACTIVE_STATE],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.ACTIVE_STATE.value)

        # L3: Relevant Memory
        memory_content = self._build_memory_layer(goal, task_state)
        if memory_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.RELEVANT_MEMORY,
                memory_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.RELEVANT_MEMORY],
            )
            layers.append(layer)

        # L4: Tool Results
        tool_content = self._build_tool_results_layer(tool_results)
        if tool_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.TOOL_RESULTS,
                tool_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.TOOL_RESULTS],
            )
            layers.append(layer)

        # L5: Verification State
        verify_content = self._build_verification_layer(verification_state)
        if verify_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.VERIFICATION_STATE,
                verify_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.VERIFICATION_STATE],
            )
            layers.append(layer)

        # L6: Conversation
        conv_content = self._build_conversation_layer(conversation_history)
        if conv_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.CONVERSATION,
                conv_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.CONVERSATION],
            )
            layers.append(layer)

        # Apply budget: sort by priority, include until budget exhausted
        final_layers = self._apply_budget(layers, budget, diagnostics)

        total_tokens = sum(l.tokens for l in final_layers)
        truncated = any(l.truncated for l in final_layers)
        build_latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start_time) * 1000

        if diagnostics:
            diagnostics.context_tokens = total_tokens
            diagnostics.budget = budget
            diagnostics.build_latency_ms = build_latency_ms
            diagnostics.layers_truncated = [l.layer.value for l in final_layers if l.truncated]
            diagnostics.compression_count = len(layers) - len(final_layers)

        return BuiltContext(
            layers=final_layers,
            total_tokens=total_tokens,
            budget=budget,
            provider=provider,
            model=model,
            truncated=truncated,
            truncation_details={
                "original_layer_count": len(layers),
                "final_layer_count": len(final_layers),
                "layers_truncated": [l.layer.value for l in final_layers if l.truncated],
            },
            diagnostics=diagnostics,
        )

    def _build_layer(
        self,
        layer: ContextLayer,
        content: str,
        budget: int,
        max_layer_tokens: int,
    ) -> LayerContent:
        """Build a layer with token counting and truncation."""
        tokens = self.tokens.count(content)
        truncated = False

        if tokens > max_layer_tokens:
            # Truncate to layer max
            max_chars = max_layer_tokens * 4
            content = content[:max_chars] + f"\n... [truncated from {tokens} tokens]"
            tokens = max_layer_tokens
            truncated = True

        return LayerContent(
            layer=layer,
            content=content,
            tokens=tokens,
            priority=LAYER_PRIORITY[layer],
            truncated=truncated,
        )

    def _apply_budget(self, layers: List[LayerContent], budget: int, diagnostics: Optional[ContextDiagnostics] = None) -> List[LayerContent]:
        """Apply token budget, keeping highest priority layers first."""
        # Sort by priority (highest first)
        sorted_layers = sorted(layers, key=lambda l: l.priority, reverse=True)

        result = []
        used = 0

        for layer in sorted_layers:
            if used + layer.tokens <= budget:
                result.append(layer)
                used += layer.tokens
            elif used < budget:
                # Try to fit a truncated version
                remaining = budget - used
                if remaining > 50:  # minimum useful tokens
                    # Truncate content
                    max_chars = remaining * 4
                    truncated_content = layer.content[:max_chars] + "\n... [budget truncated]"
                    result.append(LayerContent(
                        layer=layer.layer,
                        content=truncated_content,
                        tokens=remaining,
                        priority=layer.priority,
                        truncated=True,
                    ))
                    if diagnostics:
                        diagnostics.layers_truncated.append(layer.layer.value)
                    used = budget
                break
            else:
                if diagnostics:
                    diagnostics.layers_truncated.append(layer.layer.value)
                break

        # Restore original layer order for prompt assembly
        layer_order = {l.layer: i for i, l in enumerate(layers)}
        result.sort(key=lambda l: layer_order.get(l.layer, 999))

        return result

    def _build_task_layer(
        self,
        goal: str,
        current_step: str,
        plan: Optional[List[Dict]],
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState],
    ) -> str:
        """Build L1: Current Task layer."""
        parts = [f"GOAL: {goal}"]
        if current_step:
            parts.append(f"CURRENT STEP: {current_step}")
        if task_state:
            if task_state.completed_steps:
                parts.append(f"COMPLETED: {', '.join(task_state.completed_steps[-5:])}")
            if task_state.failed_steps:
                parts.append(f"FAILED: {', '.join(task_state.failed_steps[-3:])}")
            if task_state.verified_facts:
                parts.append(f"VERIFIED: {', '.join(task_state.verified_facts[-3:])}")
        if plan:
            step_ids = [s.get("step_id", "") for s in plan if s.get("step_id")]
            if step_ids:
                parts.append(f"PLAN: {' → '.join(step_ids)}")
        return "\n".join(parts)

    def _build_active_state_layer(
        self,
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState],
    ) -> str:
        """Build L2: Active State layer."""
        parts = []
        if task_state:
            if task_state.pending_actions:
                parts.append(f"PENDING: {', '.join(task_state.pending_actions[-5:])}")
            if task_state.artifacts:
                artifacts = list(task_state.artifacts.items())[-3:]
                parts.append(f"ARTIFACTS: {', '.join(f'{k}={v[:50]}' for k, v in artifacts)}")
            if task_state.capability_states:
                caps = []
                for cap, state in list(task_state.capability_states.items())[-5:]:
                    status = state.get("status", "unknown")
                    caps.append(f"{cap}={status}")
                if caps:
                    parts.append(f"CAPABILITIES: {', '.join(caps)}")
        # Working memory
        try:
            wm = self.memory.working.latest()
            if wm:
                parts.append(f"WORKING: {str(wm)[:200]}")
        except Exception:
            pass
        return "\n".join(parts)

    def _build_memory_layer(
        self,
        goal: str,
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState],
    ) -> str:
        """Build L3: Relevant Memory layer."""
        parts = []

        # Retrieve relevant memories
        try:
            entities = []
            if task_state:
                entities.extend(task_state.relevant_memory)
            hits = self.memory.retrieve_relevant(
                goal,
                limit=5,
                entities=entities,
            )
            for hit in hits[:3]:
                content = hit.get("content", "")[:200]
                mtype = hit.get("memory_type", "")
                score = hit.get("score", 0)
                parts.append(f"[{mtype} score={score:.2f}] {content}")
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Explicit facts
        try:
            facts = self.memory.explicit_memories()
            if facts:
                fact_items = list(facts.items())[:3]
                parts.append("FACTS: " + "; ".join(f"{k}: {v[:100]}" for k, v in fact_items))
        except Exception:
            pass

        return "\n".join(parts)

    def _build_tool_results_layer(
        self,
        tool_results: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]],
    ) -> str:
        """Build L4: Tool Results layer."""
        if not tool_results:
            return ""

        parts = []
        for result in tool_results[-5:]:  # Last 5 results
            normalized = ToolOutputNormalizer.normalize(result, max_tokens=200)
            if normalized:
                parts.append(normalized)
        return "\n".join(parts)

    def _build_verification_layer(
        self,
        verification_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    ) -> str:
        """Build L5: Verification State layer."""
        if not verification_state:
            return ""

        parts = []
        passed = verification_state.get("passed_steps", 0)
        failed = verification_state.get("failed_steps", 0)
        parts.append(f"VERIFICATION: {passed} passed, {failed} failed")

        capability_states = verification_state.get("capability_states", {})
        if capability_states:
            cap_status = []
            for cap, state in list(capability_states.items())[-5:]:
                status = state.get("verification", {}).get("passed", False)
                cap_status.append(f"{cap}={'PASS' if status else 'FAIL'}")
            parts.append("CAPABILITIES: " + ", ".join(cap_status))

        return "\n".join(parts)

    def _build_conversation_layer(
        self,
        conversation_history: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]],
    ) -> str:
        """Build L6: Recent Conversation layer."""
        if not conversation_history:
            return ""

        # Compact: keep last 4 turns, summarize older
        recent = conversation_history[-4:]
        parts = []
        for turn in recent:
            role = turn.get("role", "user")
            content = turn.get("content", "")[:300]
            parts.append(f"{role}: {content}")

        if len(conversation_history) > 4:
            parts.insert(0, f"[... {len(conversation_history) - 4} earlier turns summarized]")

        return "\n".join(parts)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Context Manager
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------


class ContextManager:
    """
    Main context management interface.

    Coordinates context building, budgeting, checkpoints, and compression.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        memory_manager: MemoryManager,
        model_manager: ModelManager,
        default_budget: Optional[int] = None,
    ):
        self.memory = memory_manager
        self.models = model_manager
        self.builder = ContextBuilder(memory_manager, model_manager)
        self.default_budget = default_budget
        self._checkpoints: Dict[str, ContextCheckpoint] = {}
        self._current_task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState] = None
        self._conversation_history: List[Dict[str, str]] = []

    def build_context(
        self,
        goal: str,
        current_step: str = "",
        plan: Optional[List[Dict]] = None,
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState] = None,
        tool_results: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        verification_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        conversation_history: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
        system_prompt: str = "",
        provider: Optional[ProviderType] = None,
        model: str = "",
        budget: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> BuiltContext:
        """Build context for current model call."""
        # Resolve provider if not specified
        if provider is None:
            provider = self._detect_provider(model)

        # Use current task state if available
        task_state = self._current_task_state

        # Use provided conversation history or fall back to internal
        conv_history = conversation_history if conversation_history is not None else self._conversation_history

        return self.builder.build(
            goal=goal,
            current_step=current_step,
            plan=plan,
            task_state=task_state,
            tool_results=tool_results,
            verification_state=verification_state,
            conversation_history=conv_history,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            provider=provider,
            model=model,
            budget=budget or self.default_budget,
            enable_diagnostics=True,
        )

    def _detect_provider(self, model: str) -> ProviderType:
        """Detect provider from model name."""
        if not model:
            return ProviderType.UNKNOWN
        model_lower = model.lower()
        if "ollama" in model_lower or any(m in model_lower for m in ["llama", "qwen", "mistral"]):
            return ProviderType.OLLAMA
        if "builtin" in model_lower or "gguf" in model_lower or model_lower == "hercule-local":
            return ProviderType.BUILTIN
        if "hercule" in model_lower:
            return ProviderType.HERCULE_LM
        if "mock" in model_lower:
            return ProviderType.MOCK
        return ProviderType.UNKNOWN

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Task State Management
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def start_task(self, goal: str) -> StructuredTaskState:
        """Initialize task state for a new goal."""
        self._current_task_state = StructuredTaskState(goal=goal)
        self._conversation_history = []
        return self._current_task_state

    def update_task_state(
        self,
        current_step: Optional[str] = None,
        completed_step: Optional[str] = None,
        failed_step: Optional[str] = None,
        verified_fact: Optional[str] = None,
        pending_action: Optional[str] = None,
        artifact: Optional[Tuple[str, str]] = None,
        capability_state: Optional[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    ) -> StructuredTaskState:
        """Update task state incrementally."""
        if self._current_task_state is None:
            self._current_task_state = StructuredTaskState()

        if current_step:
            self._current_task_state.current_step = current_step
        if completed_step:
            if completed_step not in self._current_task_state.completed_steps:
                self._current_task_state.completed_steps.append(completed_step)
        if failed_step:
            if failed_step not in self._current_task_state.failed_steps:
                self._current_task_state.failed_steps.append(failed_step)
        if verified_fact:
            if verified_fact not in self._current_task_state.verified_facts:
                self._current_task_state.verified_facts.append(verified_fact)
        if pending_action:
            if pending_action not in self._current_task_state.pending_actions:
                self._current_task_state.pending_actions.append(pending_action)
        if artifact:
            key, value = artifact
            self._current_task_state.artifacts[key] = value
        if capability_state:
            cap, state = capability_state
            self._current_task_state.capability_states[cap] = state

        return self._current_task_state

    def get_task_state(self) -> Optional[StructuredTaskState]:
        """Get current task state."""
        return self._current_task_state

    def clear_task(self):
        """Clear task state and conversation history."""
        self._current_task_state = None
        self._conversation_history = []

    def add_conversation_turn(self, role: str, content: str):
        """Add a conversation turn."""
        self._conversation_history.append({
            "role": role,
            "content": content,
            "timestamp": time.time(),
        })
        # Keep history bounded
        if len(self._conversation_history) > 20:
            self._conversation_history = self._conversation_history[-20:]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Checkpoint / Resume
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def create_checkpoint(
        self,
        provider: Optional[ProviderType] = None,
        model: str = "",
        budget: Optional[int] = None,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> ContextCheckpoint:
        """Create a context checkpoint for resume."""
        if self._current_task_state is None:
            raise ValueError("No active task state to checkpoint")

        # Build current context for checkpoint
        context = self.build_context(
            goal=self._current_task_state.goal,
            current_step=self._current_task_state.current_step,
            task_state=self._current_task_state,
            conversation_history=self._conversation_history,
            provider=provider,
            model=model,
            budget=budget,
        )

        checkpoint = ContextCheckpoint(
            checkpoint_id=self._current_task_state.checkpoint_id,
            task_state=self._current_task_state,
            context_layers={lc.layer: lc for lc in context.layers},
            provider=provider or ProviderType.UNKNOWN,
            model=model,
            total_tokens=context.total_tokens,
            budget=context.budget,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )

        self._checkpoints[checkpoint.checkpoint_id] = checkpoint
        logger.info(f"Created context checkpoint: {checkpoint.checkpoint_id}")
        return checkpoint

    def restore_checkpoint(self, checkpoint_id: str) -> Optional[ContextCheckpoint]:
        """Restore task state from checkpoint with schema validation."""
        checkpoint = self._checkpoints.get(checkpoint_id)
        if not checkpoint:
            logger.warning(f"Checkpoint not found: {checkpoint_id}")
            return None

        # Validate schema version
        schema_version = getattr(checkpoint, 'schema_version', 0)
        if schema_version != CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION:
            logger.error(f"Checkpoint schema version mismatch: expected {CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION}, got {schema_version}")
            return None

        # Validate checkpoint integrity
        if not self._validate_checkpoint(checkpoint):
            logger.error(f"Checkpoint validation failed: {checkpoint_id}")
            return None

        self._current_task_state = checkpoint.task_state
        logger.info(f"Restored context checkpoint: {checkpoint_id}")
        return checkpoint

    def _validate_checkpoint(self, checkpoint: ContextCheckpoint) -> bool:
        """Validate checkpoint integrity."""
        try:
            # Check required fields
            if not checkpoint.checkpoint_id:
                return False
            if not checkpoint.task_state:
                return False
            if not checkpoint.task_state.goal:
                return False
            if not checkpoint.task_state.checkpoint_id:
                return False
            if checkpoint.total_tokens < 0:
                return False
            if checkpoint.budget <= 0:
                return False
            # Validate provider
            if checkpoint.provider not in ProviderType:
                return False
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Checkpoint validation error: {e}")
            return False

    def list_checkpoints(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """List available checkpoints."""
        return [
            {
                "checkpoint_id": cp.checkpoint_id,
                "goal": cp.task_state.goal,
                "current_step": cp.task_state.current_step,
                "completed_steps": len(cp.task_state.completed_steps),
                "created_at": cp.created_at,
                "tokens": cp.total_tokens,
            }
            for cp in self._checkpoints.values()
        ]

    def delete_checkpoint(self, checkpoint_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete a checkpoint."""
        if checkpoint_id in self._checkpoints:
            del self._checkpoints[checkpoint_id]
            return True
        return False

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compression
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def compress_context(self, context: BuiltContext, target_budget: int) -> BuiltContext:
        """Compress context to fit within target budget."""
        if context.total_tokens <= target_budget:
            return context

        if target_budget <= 0:
            logger.error(f"Invalid target budget: {target_budget}")
            target_budget = 512  # Minimum safe budget

        # Re-apply budget with lower limit
        compressed_layers = self.builder._apply_budget(context.layers, target_budget)

        return BuiltContext(
            layers=compressed_layers,
            total_tokens=sum(l.tokens for l in compressed_layers),
            budget=target_budget,
            provider=context.provider,
            model=context.model,
            truncated=True,
            truncation_details={
                **context.truncation_details,
                "compressed_from": context.total_tokens,
                "compressed_to": target_budget,
            },
        )

    def compact_conversation(self, keep_turns: int = 4) -> str:
        """Create a compact summary of conversation history."""
        if len(self._conversation_history) <= keep_turns:
            return ""

        old_turns = self._conversation_history[:-keep_turns]
        # Simple summarization: extract key topics
        topics = set()
        for turn in old_turns:
            content = turn.get("content", "").lower()
            # Extract potential topics (capitalized words, file paths, etc.)
            import re
            words = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\.[a-z]+)?\b', content)
            topics.update(words[:5])

        summary = f"[Previous conversation: {len(old_turns)} turns. Topics: {', '.join(list(topics)[:10])}]"
        return summary

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Failure Recovery
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def recover_from_corrupted_context(self, context: BuiltContext) -> BuiltContext:
        """Attempt to recover from corrupted context by rebuilding with safe defaults."""
        logger.warning("Attempting context recovery from corruption")
        
        # If context is corrupted, rebuild with minimal safe context
        safe_layers = []
        for layer in context.layers:
            if layer.layer in (ContextLayer.SYSTEM, ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK):
                safe_layers.append(layer)
        
        # Ensure we have at least SYSTEM layer
        if not any(l.layer == ContextLayer.SYSTEM for l in safe_layers):
            safe_layers.insert(0, LayerContent(
                layer=ContextLayer.SYSTEM,
                content="System: Safe mode - context recovered from corruption",
                tokens=20,
                priority=LAYER_PRIORITY[ContextLayer.SYSTEM],
                truncated=False,
            ))
        
        return BuiltContext(
            layers=safe_layers,
            total_tokens=sum(l.tokens for l in safe_layers),
            budget=context.budget,
            provider=context.provider,
            model=context.model,
            truncated=True,
            truncation_details={
                "recovered_from_corruption": True,
                "original_layers": len(context.layers),
                "recovered_layers": len(safe_layers),
            },
        )

    def recover_from_invalid_budget(self, budget: int) -> int:
        """Recover from invalid budget by clamping to valid range."""
        if budget <= 0:
            logger.warning(f"Invalid budget {budget}, using minimum safe budget")
            return 512
        if budget > 32768:
            logger.warning(f"Budget {budget} exceeds maximum, clamping to 32768")
            return 32768
        return budget

    def recover_from_unknown_provider(self, provider: ProviderType) -> Tuple[ProviderType, int]:
        """Recover from unknown provider by using safe defaults."""
        if provider == ProviderType.UNKNOWN:
            logger.warning("Unknown provider, using safe defaults (builtin)")
            return ProviderType.BUILTIN, DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGETS[ProviderType.BUILTIN]
        return provider, DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.get(provider, 2048)

    def get_diagnostics_summary(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get summary of context manager state for observability."""
        return {
            "active_task": self._current_task_state.goal if self._current_task_state else None,
            "task_step": self._current_task_state.current_step if self._current_task_state else None,
            "completed_steps": len(self._current_task_state.completed_steps) if self._current_task_state else 0,
            "checkpoints": len(self._checkpoints),
            "conversation_turns": len(self._conversation_history),
            "schema_version": CONTEXT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        }

@dataclass
class RankedMemoryItem:
    """A memory item with relevance ranking."""
    content: str
    memory_type: str
    score: float
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tokens: int = 0
    density_score: float = 0.0


@dataclass
class CompactedMemory:
    """Compacted memory with high information density."""
    summary: str
    original_tokens: int
    compacted_tokens: int
    compression_ratio: float
    key_points: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


class InformationDensityScorer:
    """Score information density of text content."""
    
    # High-value patterns (more informative per token)
    HIGH_VALUE_PATTERNS = [
        (r'(?:^|\s)(def|class|function|import|from)\b', 2.0),      # Code structures
        (r'(?:^|\s)(error|exception|failed|success)\b', 1.5),      # Outcomes
        (r'(?:^|\s)(path|file|directory|config)\b', 1.5),          # File ops
        (r'(?:^|\s)(step|goal|plan|verify)\b', 1.5),               # Task structure
        (r'\d+\.?\d*', 1.2),                                  # Numbers
        (r'[A-Z][a-z]+(?:[A-Z][a-z]+)+', 1.3),               # CamelCase identifiers
    ]
    
    # Low-value patterns (less informative per token)
    LOW_VALUE_PATTERNS = [
        (r'(?:^|\s)(the|a|an|is|are|was|were|be|been|being)\b', 0.3),
        (r'(?:^|\s)(and|or|but|so|because|however|therefore)\b', 0.4),
        (r'(?:^|\s)(i|you|we|they|he|she|it)\b', 0.4),
        (r'(?:^|\s)(this|that|these|those)\b', 0.4),
        (r'\s+', 0.1),  # Whitespace
    ]
    
    def __init__(self, token_counter: TokenCounter):
        self.token_counter = token_counter
    
    def score(self, text: str) -> float:
        """Calculate information density score (higher = more dense)."""
        if not text:
            return 0.0
        
        tokens = self.token_counter.count(text)
        if tokens == 0:
            return 0.0
        
        score = 1.0  # Base score
        
        import re
        for pattern, weight in self.HIGH_VALUE_PATTERNS:
            matches = len(re.findall(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE))
            score += matches * weight
        
        for pattern, weight in self.LOW_VALUE_PATTERNS:
            matches = len(re.findall(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE))
            score -= matches * (1.0 - weight)
        
        # Normalize by token count
        density = max(0.1, score / tokens * 100)
        return min(10.0, density)  # Cap at 10
    
    def rank_items(self, items: List[RankedMemoryItem]) -> List[RankedMemoryItem]:
        """Rank memory items by combined relevance and density."""
        for item in items:
            density = self.score(item.content)
            item.density_score = density
            # Combined score: relevance * density
            item.tokens = self.token_counter.count(item.content)
            item.metadata['density'] = density
            item.metadata['combined_score'] = item.score * density
        
        # Sort by combined score descending
        items.sort(key=lambda x: x.metadata.get('combined_score', 0), reverse=True)
        return items


class MemoryCompactor:
    """Compact memories to increase information density."""
    
    def __init__(self, token_counter: TokenCounter, target_ratio: float = 0.3):
        self.token_counter = token_counter
        self.target_ratio = target_ratio
    
    def compact(self, items: List[RankedMemoryItem], max_tokens: int) -> CompactedMemory:
        """Compact multiple memory items into dense summary."""
        if not items:
            return CompactedMemory(
                summary="",
                original_tokens=0,
                compacted_tokens=0,
                compression_ratio=0.0,
            )
        
        # Combine all content
        full_content = "\n".join(f"[{i.memory_type}] {i.content}" for i in items)
        original_tokens = self.token_counter.count(full_content)
        
        # Extract key points (first sentence of each, or high-density segments)
        key_points = []
        for item in items:
            sentences = item.content.split('. ')
            if sentences:
                # Take first sentence or most dense segment
                key_points.append(sentences[0][:200])
        
        # Create summary
        summary_parts = []
        summary_parts.append(f"Retrieved {len(items)} memories:")
        for i, (item, point) in enumerate(zip(items, key_points)):
            summary_parts.append(f"  {i+1}. [{item.memory_type} score={item.score:.2f}] {point}")
        
        summary = "\n".join(summary_parts)
        compacted_tokens = self.token_counter.count(summary)
        
        # If still too long, truncate
        if compacted_tokens > max_tokens:
            max_chars = max_tokens * 4
            summary = summary[:max_chars] + "..."
            compacted_tokens = self.token_counter.count(summary)
        
        ratio = compacted_tokens / max(1, original_tokens)
        
        return CompactedMemory(
            summary=summary,
            original_tokens=original_tokens,
            compacted_tokens=compacted_tokens,
            compression_ratio=ratio,
            key_points=key_points,
        )


class EnhancedContextBuilder(ContextBuilder):
    """Enhanced context builder with information density optimization."""
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        memory_manager: MemoryManager,
        model_manager: Any,
        token_counter: Optional[TokenCounter] = None,
        task_classification: Optional[TaskClassification] = None,
    ):
        super().__init__(memory_manager, model_manager, token_counter)
        self.task_classification = task_classification
        self.density_scorer = InformationDensityScorer(token_counter or TokenCounter())
        self.compactor = MemoryCompactor(token_counter or TokenCounter())
        self.profile = get_runtime_profile()
        self.profile_config = get_profile_config(self.profile)
    
    def build(
        self,
        goal: str,
        current_step: str = "",
        plan: Optional[List[Dict]] = None,
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState] = None,
        tool_results: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        verification_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        conversation_history: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
        system_prompt: str = "",
        provider: ProviderType = ProviderType.UNKNOWN,
        model: str = "",
        budget: Optional[int] = None,
        enable_diagnostics: bool = False,
    ) -> BuiltContext:
        """Build context with density optimization."""
        start_time = time.perf_counter()
        
        # Determine budget from profile if not specified
        if budget is None:
            budget = self.profile_config.get("max_context_tokens", 
                DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.get(provider, 2048))
        
        self.tokens.set_provider(provider if isinstance(provider, ContextLayer) else provider)
        
        if isinstance(provider, str):
            # Convert string to ProviderType
            try:
                provider = ProviderType(provider)
            except ValueError:
                provider = ProviderType.UNKNOWN
        
        layers = []
        diagnostics = ContextDiagnostics() if enable_diagnostics else None
        
        if diagnostics:
            diagnostics.provider = provider.value
            diagnostics.model = model
            diagnostics.budget = budget
        
        # L0: System (always included)
        if system_prompt:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.SYSTEM,
                system_prompt,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.SYSTEM],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.SYSTEM.value)
        
        # L1: Current Task (always included for active tasks)
        task_content = self._build_task_layer(goal, current_step, plan, task_state)
        if task_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK,
                task_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.CURRENT_TASK.value)
        
        # L2: Active State
        state_content = self._build_active_state_layer(task_state)
        if state_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.ACTIVE_STATE,
                state_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.ACTIVE_STATE],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.ACTIVE_STATE.value)
        
        # L3: Relevant Memory (DENSITY OPTIMIZED)
        memory_content = self._build_memory_layer_dense(goal, task_state, budget)
        if memory_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.RELEVANT_MEMORY,
                memory_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.RELEVANT_MEMORY],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.RELEVANT_MEMORY.value)
                diagnostics.memory_items_selected += 1
        
        # L4: Tool Results (normalized)
        tool_content = self._build_tool_results_layer(tool_results)
        if tool_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.TOOL_RESULTS,
                tool_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.TOOL_RESULTS],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.TOOL_RESULTS.value)
                diagnostics.tool_results_selected += 1
        
        # L5: Verification State
        verify_content = self._build_verification_layer(verification_state)
        if verify_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.VERIFICATION_STATE,
                verify_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.VERIFICATION_STATE],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.VERIFICATION_STATE.value)
        
        # L6: Conversation (compacted)
        conv_content = self._build_conversation_layer_dense(conversation_history, budget)
        if conv_content:
            layer = self._build_layer(
                ContextLayer.CONVERSATION,
                conv_content,
                budget,
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.CONVERSATION],
            )
            layers.append(layer)
            if diagnostics:
                diagnostics.layers_included.append(ContextLayer.CONVERSATION.value)
                diagnostics.conversation_turns_selected = len(conversation_history or [])
        
        # Apply density-aware budget
        final_layers = self._apply_density_budget(layers, budget, diagnostics)
        
        total_tokens = sum(l.tokens for l in final_layers)
        truncated = any(l.truncated for l in final_layers)
        build_latency_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start_time) * 1000
        
        if diagnostics:
            diagnostics.context_tokens = total_tokens
            diagnostics.budget = budget
            diagnostics.build_latency_ms = build_latency_ms
            diagnostics.layers_truncated = [l.layer.value for l in final_layers if l.truncated]
            diagnostics.compression_count = len(layers) - len(final_layers)
        
        return BuiltContext(
            layers=final_layers,
            total_tokens=total_tokens,
            budget=budget,
            provider=provider,
            model=model,
            truncated=truncated,
            truncation_details={
                "original_layer_count": len(layers),
                "final_layer_count": len(final_layers),
                "layers_truncated": [l.layer.value for l in final_layers if l.truncated],
                "density_optimized": True,
            },
            diagnostics=diagnostics,
        )
    
    def _build_memory_layer_dense(
        self,
        goal: str,
        task_state: Optional[StructuredTaskState],
        budget: int,
    ) -> str:
        """Build memory layer with retrieve-rank-compact-inject."""
        try:
            # Retrieve
            entities = []
            if task_state:
                entities.extend(task_state.relevant_memory)
            
            hits = self.memory.retrieve_relevant(
                goal,
                limit=10,  # Retrieve more for ranking
                entities=entities,
            )
            
            if not hits:
                return ""
            
            # Convert to ranked items
            ranked_items = []
            for hit in hits:
                content = hit.get("content", "")
                if not content:
                    continue
                ranked_items.append(RankedMemoryItem(
                    content=content[:500],  # Limit individual item size
                    memory_type=hit.get("memory_type", "unknown"),
                    score=hit.get("score", 0.5),
                    metadata=hit,
                ))
            
            # Rank by relevance * density
            ranked_items = self.density_scorer.rank_items(ranked_items)
            
            # Determine token budget for memory layer
            memory_budget = min(
                LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.RELEVANT_MEMORY],
                budget // 4,  # Max 25% of budget
            )
            
            # Compact top items
            compacted = self.compactor.compact(ranked_items[:5], memory_budget)
            
            return compacted.summary
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Dense memory layer failed: {e}")
            # Fallback to original
            return self._build_memory_layer(goal, task_state)
    
    def _build_conversation_layer_dense(
        self,
        conversation_history: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]],
        budget: int,
    ) -> str:
        """Build conversation layer with density-aware compaction."""
        if not conversation_history:
            return ""
        
        conv_budget = min(
            LAYER_MAX_TOKENS[ContextLayer.CONVERSATION],
            budget // 6,  # Max ~16% of budget
        )
        
        # For short conversations, keep as-is
        if len(conversation_history) <= 4:
            return self._build_conversation_layer(conversation_history)
        
        # For longer conversations, compact older turns
        recent = conversation_history[-4:]
        older = conversation_history[:-4]
        
        parts = []
        # Compact older turns
        if older:
            topics = set()
            for turn in older:
                content = turn.get("content", "").lower()
                import re
                words = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\.[a-z]+)?\b', content)
                topics.update(words[:3])
            if topics:
                parts.append(f"[... {len(older)} earlier turns. Topics: {', '.join(list(topics)[:8])}]")
        
        # Recent turns verbatim
        for turn in recent:
            role = turn.get("role", "user")
            content = turn.get("content", "")[:200]
            parts.append(f"{role}: {content}")
        
        result = "\n".join(parts)
        
        # Truncate if needed
        tokens = self.tokens.count(result)
        if tokens > conv_budget:
            max_chars = conv_budget * 4
            result = result[:max_chars] + "..."
        
        return result
    
    def _apply_density_budget(
        self,
        layers: List[LayerContent],
        budget: int,
        diagnostics: Optional[ContextDiagnostics] = None,
    ) -> List[LayerContent]:
        """Apply budget with density-aware prioritization."""
        # Score each layer by priority * average density
        scored_layers = []
        for layer in layers:
            density = 1.0
            if layer.metadata.get('density'):
                density = layer.metadata['density']
            elif layer.content:
                density = self.density_scorer.score(layer.content)
            
            effective_priority = layer.priority * density
            scored_layers.append((effective_priority, layer))
        
        # Sort by effective priority
        scored_layers.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        
        result = []
        used = 0
        
        for eff_priority, layer in scored_layers:
            if used + layer.tokens <= budget:
                result.append(layer)
                used += layer.tokens
            elif used < budget:
                remaining = budget - used
                if remaining > 50:
                    max_chars = remaining * 4
                    truncated_content = layer.content[:max_chars] + "\n... [budget truncated]"
                    result.append(LayerContent(
                        layer=layer.layer,
                        content=truncated_content,
                        tokens=remaining,
                        priority=layer.priority,
                        truncated=True,
                    ))
                    if diagnostics:
                        diagnostics.layers_truncated.append(layer.layer.value)
                    used = budget
                break
            else:
                if diagnostics:
                    diagnostics.layers_truncated.append(layer.layer.value)
                break
        
        # Restore original layer order for prompt assembly
        layer_order = {l.layer: i for i, l in enumerate(layers)}
        result.sort(key=lambda l: layer_order.get(l.layer, 999))
        
        return result

"""
--------------------------------------------
HERCULE AI Operating System
Module: Context Priority Classes & Budgets
Author: Heeran Paul
License: MIT
--------------------------------------------

CRITICAL   system/task identity — never dropped for size.
IMPORTANT  high-signal items — dropped only after all lower classes.
RELEVANT   useful supporting items.
OPTIONAL   nice-to-have filler.
DISCARDABLE below the relevance floor.

``apply_budgets`` enforces an explicit token budget plus optional
per-source caps, returning the selected items and a diagnostic trail
explaining every removal/compression.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

_CRITICAL_SOURCES = {"current_request", "task", "task_instructions", "system"}


class PriorityClass(str, Enum):
    CRITICAL = "critical"
    IMPORTANT = "important"
    RELEVANT = "relevant"
    OPTIONAL = "optional"
    DISCARDABLE = "discardable"


@dataclass
class BudgetConfig:
    total_tokens: int = 512
    per_source_tokens: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    protected: Tuple[str, ...] = (PriorityClass.CRITICAL.value,)
    compress: bool = True
    compressed_chars: int = 200


def classify_priority(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> PriorityClass:
    """Deterministic priority from source + attention/relevance signals."""
    source = str(item.get("source", ""))
    if source in _CRITICAL_SOURCES:
        return PriorityClass.CRITICAL
    score = float(item.get("attention_score", item.get("relevance", 0.0)) or 0.0)
    relevance = float(item.get("relevance", 0.0) or 0.0)
    if score >= 0.7 or relevance >= 0.8:
        return PriorityClass.IMPORTANT
    if score >= 0.4:
        return PriorityClass.RELEVANT
    if score >= 0.15:
        return PriorityClass.OPTIONAL
    return PriorityClass.DISCARDABLE


def default_count_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    return max(1, len(str(text).split()) + 10)


def apply_budgets(
    ranked_items: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    budget: BudgetConfig,
    count_tokens: Optional[Callable[[str], int]] = None,
) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Filter -> deduplicate-assumed -> budget -> order.

    ``ranked_items`` must already be rank-ordered (best first); selection
    preserves that order. Returns (selected, diagnostics).
    """
    count = count_tokens or default_count_tokens
    diagnostics: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    tagged: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in ranked_items:
        entry = dict(item)
        entry["priority"] = classify_priority(entry).value
        tagged.append(entry)

    protected = [i for i in tagged if i["priority"] in budget.protected]
    rest = [i for i in tagged if i["priority"] not in budget.protected]
    dropped_classes = {i["priority"] for i in tagged if i["priority"] == PriorityClass.DISCARDABLE.value}
    candidates = protected + [i for i in rest if i["priority"] != PriorityClass.DISCARDABLE.value]
    for priority in sorted(dropped_classes):
        diagnostics.append({"action": "removed", "priority": priority, "reason": "below relevance floor"})

    # Per-source caps (protected items bypass caps).
    if budget.per_source_tokens:
        usage: Dict[str, int] = {}
        capped: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for item in candidates:
            if item["priority"] in budget.protected:
                capped.append(item)
                continue
            source = str(item.get("source", ""))
            cap = budget.per_source_tokens.get(source)
            cost = count(str(item.get("text", "")))
            if cap is not None and usage.get(source, 0) + cost > cap:
                diagnostics.append({"action": "removed", "source": source, "priority": item["priority"], "reason": f"per-source cap {cap}"})
                continue
            usage[source] = usage.get(source, 0) + cost
            capped.append(item)
        candidates = capped

    # Total budget in rank order; protected items always fit at least one.
    selected: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    total = 0
    for item in candidates:
        cost = count(str(item.get("text", "")))
        if total + cost > budget.total_tokens:
            if item["priority"] in budget.protected:
                if budget.compress:
                    # Compress the protected item itself rather than dropping it.
                    remaining = budget.total_tokens - total
                    words = str(item.get("text", "")).split()
                    keep = max(1, remaining - 10)
                    item["text"] = " ".join(words[:keep]) + ("..." if len(words) > keep else "")
                    item["compressed"] = True
                    selected.append(item)
                    total += count(item["text"])
                    diagnostics.append({"action": "compressed", "source": item.get("source"), "priority": item["priority"], "reason": "protected item over budget"})
                elif not selected:
                    selected.append(item)
                    total += cost
                    diagnostics.append({"action": "kept-over-budget", "source": item.get("source"), "priority": item["priority"], "reason": "protected item"})
                else:
                    diagnostics.append({"action": "removed", "source": item.get("source"), "priority": item["priority"], "reason": f"total budget {budget.total_tokens}"})
            else:
                diagnostics.append({"action": "removed", "source": item.get("source"), "priority": item["priority"], "reason": f"total budget {budget.total_tokens}"})
            continue
        selected.append(item)
        total += cost

    # Optional compression of the lowest-priority selections.
    if budget.compress:
        for item in reversed(selected):
            if total <= budget.total_tokens:
                break
            if item["priority"] in budget.protected:
                continue
            text = str(item.get("text", ""))
            if len(text) > budget.compressed_chars:
                item["text"] = text[: budget.compressed_chars].rstrip() + "..."
                item["compressed"] = True
                total = sum(count(str(i.get("text", ""))) for i in selected)
                diagnostics.append({"action": "compressed", "source": item.get("source"), "priority": item["priority"], "reason": "fit total budget"})

    # Order: protected first (rank order), then the rest in rank order.
    order = {PriorityClass.CRITICAL.value: 0, PriorityClass.IMPORTANT.value: 1, PriorityClass.RELEVANT.value: 2, PriorityClass.OPTIONAL.value: 3}
    selected.sort(key=lambda i: order.get(i.get("priority", ""), 4))
    return selected, diagnostics
